blocks.text: Ikki xil ergash gap: aniqlovchi va qo'shimcha ma'lumot

92–94-darslarda (asoslari → qizil kitob, 101–102-darslar) **aniqlovchi** ergash gaplarni (defining clauses) o'rgandik. Ular qaysi odam yoki narsa haqida gap ketayotganini **aniqlab beradi**: The woman **who lives next door** is a doctor — qaysi ayol? Qo'shnimiz. Bu darsda ikkinchi turi — **qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi** ergash gap (extra information / non-defining clause). U kim yoki nima haqida gapirayotganimizni aniqlamaydi, chunki bu allaqachon ma'lum. U faqat yo'l-yo'lakay **qo'shimcha xabar** qo'shadi: My brother Aziz, **who lives in London**, is a doctor. Aziz kimligi ismidan ma'lum, «Londonda yashaydi» — shunchaki qo'shimcha ma'lumot.

rows: **bor**: ikki tomonida yoki gap oxirida bittasi
to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa mumkin: the film I saw

blocks.text: O'zbek tilida ikkala tur ham sifatdosh bilan otdan oldin keladi: «**Londonda yashaydigan** akam». Akangiz bitta bo'lsa — bu qo'shimcha ma'lumot, bir nechta bo'lsa — aniqlovchi; o'zbekchada bu farq ko'rinmaydi. Inglizchada farqni **vergul** ko'rsatadi, og'zaki nutqda esa vergul o'rnida kichik **pauza** qilinadi. Shuning uchun bunday gaplarni tarjima qilganda sifatdoshdan tashqari «— u ... —» yoki «..., u esa ...» kabi qo'shimcha gap ham qulay.

Odam uchun **who**, narsa, joy va hayvon uchun **which**. Ergash gap gapning o'rtasida bo'lsa, u **ikki vergul** orasiga olinadi; gapning oxirida bo'lsa — **bitta vergul** bilan ajratiladi. Bunday gaplar ko'proq yozma va rasmiy nutqda — yangiliklar, maqola, xat, taqdimotda uchraydi. Do'stlar orasidagi suhbatda odatda ikkita oddiy gap afzal ko'riladi: My brother lives in London. He's a doctor.

items.text: Our manager, **who has worked** here for twenty years, is retiring in May.
items.translation: Yigirma yildan beri shu yerda **ishlab kelayotgan** boshlig'imiz may oyida nafaqaga chiqyapti.

items.text: The new bridge, **which cost** forty million dollars, opened last week.
items.translation: **Qirq million dollarga tushgan** yangi ko'prik o'tgan hafta ochildi.

items.text: We stayed two nights in Khiva, **which is** one of the oldest towns in Central Asia.
items.translation: Xivada ikki kecha qoldik — **u** Markaziy Osiyodagi eng qadimiy shaharlardan biri.

blocks.text: Ismlar va yagona narsalar — doim vergul bilan

Ism (Aziz, Mr Brown), joy nomi (Samarkand, the Thames), «mening onam», «bizning direktor», «Yer» kabi so'zlar o'zi aniq — ularni boshqalardan ajratib ko'rsatishga hojat yo'q. Shuning uchun ulardan keyin keladigan ergash gap deyarli doim **qo'shimcha ma'lumot** bo'ladi va vergul bilan yoziladi: Samarkand, **which** ... ; my mother, **who** ... (onangiz bitta — «qaysi onam?» degan savol tug'ilmaydi).
that ishlatilmaydi, who / which tushib qolmaydi

Ikki muhim cheklov bor. Birinchidan, vergul bilan keladigan ergash gapda **that** ishlatilmaydi — faqat who yoki which. Ikkinchidan, **who / which hech qachon tushib qolmaydi**, hatto to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa ham. Aniqlovchi gapda «the film **I saw**» deyish mumkin edi (→ 93-dars), bu yerda esa yo'q: The film, **which** I saw twice, ... Odam to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa, rasmiy uslubda **whom**, og'zaki nutqda **who** ishlatiladi; ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

rows: Tashkent, **which** I love, is growing fast.
Tashkent, that I love, is growing fast.
Mr Brown, **whom** I met in Oxford, called me.
Mr Brown, I met in Oxford, called me.
My car, **which** I bought last year, is red.
My car, which I bought **it** last year, is red.
Aziz, **who** works with me, is ill.
Aziz, **which** works with me, is ill.

items.text: Professor Karimova, **whom** I interviewed for my thesis, was extremely helpful.
items.translation: Dissertatsiyam uchun **intervyu olgan** professor Karimova juda katta yordam berdi.

items.text: My cousin Jasur, **who** you met at the wedding, has moved to Seoul.
items.translation: To'yda **tanishgan** amakivachcham Jasur Seulga ko'chib ketdi.

items.text: That novel, **which** I finished in two days, is being made into a film.
items.translation: Ikki kunda **o'qib tugatgan** o'sha romanim asosida film suratga olinyapti.

blocks.text: whose, where, when — vergul bilan ham

94-darsdagi **whose** (kimning), **where** (qayerda) va **when** (qachon) ham qo'shimcha ma'lumot berishi mumkin — qoidalar o'sha: vergul qo'yiladi, that bilan almashtirilmaydi. Bu, ayniqsa, joy va vaqtga izoh berishda qulay: in Bukhara, **where** I grew up ...; in August, **when** everyone is on holiday ...

items.text: Sarah, **whose** brother is a famous chef, never cooks at home.
items.translation: **Akasi mashhur oshpaz bo'lgan** Sara uyda hech qachon ovqat pishirmaydi.

items.text: We moved to Fergana, **where** my wife's family lives.
items.translation: Farg'onaga ko'chib o'tdik — **u yerda** xotinimning oilasi yashaydi.

items.text: Come and see us in April, **when** the apricot trees are in flower.
items.translation: Aprelda mehmonga keling — **o'shanda** o'riklar gullagan bo'ladi.

blocks.text: Bir gap — ikki ma'no: vergul hal qiladi

Ba'zan vergul gapning ma'nosini butunlay o'zgartiradi. Vergulsiz gap guruhdan **bir qismini ajratadi**, vergulli gap esa **hammasi** haqida qo'shimcha xabar beradi. Yozganda vergulni unutish — kichik xato emas: o'quvchi boshqa ma'noni tushunadi.

rows: My sister **who lives in Leeds** is a teacher. (bir nechta opa-singlim bor — Lidsdagisi o'qituvchi)
My sister, **who lives in Leeds**, is a teacher. (bitta opam/singlim bor, u Lidsda yashaydi)
The students **who passed the test** got a certificate. (faqat o'tganlar oldi)
The students, **who passed the test**, got a certificate. (hamma o'tdi va hamma oldi)
He sold the car **which he bought in 2019**. (bir nechta mashinasi bor edi)
He sold his car, **which he bought in 2019**. (mashinasi bitta edi)

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Tashkent, **that** is the capital, ...» → Tashkent, **which** is the capital, ...; vergulni tushirib qoldirish: «My father who is a doctor ...» — go'yo bir nechta otangiz bordek o'qiladi → My father, **who** is a doctor, ...; olmoshni takrorlash: «My laptop, which I bought **it** in May, ...» → which I bought in May; who / which ni tashlab ketish: «Kate, I met at university, ...» → Kate, **who** I met at university, ...; odam uchun which: «My teacher, which ...» → **who**.

Tekshirish usuli: ergash gapni **qavsga** olib ko'ring yoki o'chirib tashlang. Gap baribir to'liq bo'lsa va kim yoki nima haqida ekani aniq qolsa — bu qo'shimcha ma'lumot: vergul qo'ying, **that** ishlatmang, **who / which** ni tashlamang. Vergullar aslida qavsning vazifasini bajaradi.
Predlog + **whom / which** (to whom, about which), **most of which**, **all of whom** va butun gapga ishora qiluvchi **which** (He was late, **which** annoyed everyone) — keyingi darsda (→ 96-dars).

rows: My aunt, **who** is a nurse, works nights.
The museum, **which** opened in May, is free.
Mr Lee, **whom** I met in Leeds, called me.
Bukhara, **where** I was born, is beautiful.

examples.title: **who**: extra information about people
examples.description: Odam haqida qo'shimcha ma'lumot: ism yoki aniq kishidan keyin vergul + who. Ergash gap gapning o'rtasida bo'lsa — ikki vergul orasida.

sentences.text: My grandfather, **who is** eighty-five, still works in his garden every morning.
sentences.translation: **Sakson besh yoshdagi** bobom hali ham har tong bog'ida ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza, **who speaks** four languages, works as a tour guide in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: **To'rt tilda gapiradigan** Dilnoza Samarqandda gid bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Our neighbour, **who has** three noisy dogs, complains that the street is too loud.
sentences.translation: **Uchta shovqinli iti bor** qo'shnimiz ko'cha juda shovqinli deb shikoyat qiladi.

sentences.text: Mr Collins, **who taught** me English at school, now lives in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Maktabda menga **ingliz tilidan dars bergan** mister Kollinz hozir Edinburgda yashaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod's wife, **who is** a surgeon, often works through the night.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning rafiqasi — **u jarroh** — ko'pincha tun bo'yi ishlaydi.

sentences.text: The President, **who arrived** in London on Monday, will meet the Prime Minister today.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni **Londonga kelgan** prezident bugun bosh vazir bilan uchrashadi.

sentences.text: My best friend, **who never remembers** birthdays, sent me flowers this year!
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunlarni hech qachon **eslab qolmaydigan** eng yaqin do'stim bu yil menga gul yubordi!

sentences.text: Kate's parents, **who live** in a small village near Oxford, don't have the internet.
sentences.translation: **Oksford yaqinidagi kichik qishloqda yashaydigan** Keytning ota-onasida internet yo'q.

sentences.text: Have you met Jasur, **who has** just **joined** our team?
sentences.translation: Jamoamizga **endigina qo'shilgan** Jasur bilan tanishdingizmi?

sentences.text: Aziz's grandmother, **who grew up** during the war, never throws away any food.
sentences.translation: **Urush yillarida ulg'aygan** Azizning buvisi hech qachon ovqatni tashlab yubormaydi.

examples.title: **which**: extra information about things and places
examples.description: Narsa va joy haqida qo'shimcha ma'lumot: vergul + which. Joy nomlari o'zi aniq, shuning uchun ulardan keyin doim vergul.

sentences.text: The Registan, **which was built** over several centuries, is the heart of Samarkand.
sentences.translation: **Bir necha asr davomida qurilgan** Registon — Samarqandning yuragi.

sentences.text: My laptop, **which is** only a year old, has suddenly stopped working.
sentences.translation: **Atigi bir yil oldin olingan** noutbukim to'satdan ishlamay qoldi.

sentences.text: The Thames, **which flows** through the centre of London, is about 350 kilometres long.
sentences.translation: **London markazidan oqib o'tadigan** Temza daryosining uzunligi taxminan 350 kilometr.

sentences.text: Our office, **which is** on the tenth floor, has a wonderful view of the mountains.
sentences.translation: **O'ninchi qavatda joylashgan** ofisimizdan tog'larning ajoyib manzarasi ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: This medicine, **which** you **can buy** without a prescription, helps with headaches.
sentences.translation: **Retseptsiz sotib olsa bo'ladigan** bu dori bosh og'rig'iga yordam beradi.

sentences.text: Fergana, **which is** famous for its silk, attracts thousands of visitors every year.
sentences.translation: **Ipagi bilan mashhur** Farg'ona har yili minglab mehmonlarni o'ziga tortadi.

sentences.text: The old cinema, **which closed** in 2005, is going to become a public library.
sentences.translation: 2005-yilda **yopilgan** eski kinoteatr ommaviy kutubxonaga aylantiriladi.

sentences.text: We finally sold our car, **which had** over 300,000 kilometres on the clock.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat, **spidometrida 300 ming kilometrdan oshgan** mashinamizni sotdik.

sentences.text: Sadly, the Aral Sea, **which was** once the fourth largest lake in the world, has almost disappeared.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, **bir paytlar dunyodagi to'rtinchi eng katta ko'l bo'lgan** Orol dengizi deyarli qurib bitdi.

sentences.text: Have you tried the new app, **which tells** you exactly when the next bus is coming?
sentences.translation: Keyingi avtobus qachon kelishini aniq **aytib beradigan** yangi ilovani sinab ko'rdingizmi?

examples.title: **whose**, **where** and **when** with commas
examples.description: whose (kimning), where (qayerda) va when (qachon) ham qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi — vergul bilan, that bilan almashtirilmaydi.

sentences.text: Emma, **whose** husband is a pilot, often spends her weekends alone.
sentences.translation: **Eri uchuvchi bo'lgan** Emma dam olish kunlarini ko'pincha yolg'iz o'tkazadi.

sentences.text: Bukhara, **where** my mother was born, is full of ancient mosques and madrasas.
sentences.translation: **Onam tug'ilgan** Buxoro qadimiy masjid va madrasalarga to'la.

sentences.text: We're going to Spain in October, **when** it isn't so hot.
sentences.translation: Ispaniyaga oktabrda boramiz — **o'shanda** havo unchalik issiq bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: My uncle Rustam, **whose** restaurant is in the centre of Fergana, makes the best plov in town.
sentences.translation: **Restorani Farg'ona markazida joylashgan** Rustam tog'am shahardagi eng mazali palovni damlaydi.

sentences.text: The Grand Hotel, **where** we stayed for a week, was right next to the beach.
sentences.translation: Biz bir hafta **qolgan** «Grand» mehmonxonasi plyajning shundoq yonida edi.

sentences.text: James, **whose** car had broken down, had to take a taxi to the interview.
sentences.translation: **Mashinasi buzilib qolgan** Jeyms suhbatga taksida borishga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Let's meet on Saturday, **when** the shops are less crowded.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni uchrashaylik — **o'sha kuni** do'konlarda odam kamroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Oxford, **where** Sarah studied law, is only an hour from London by train.
sentences.translation: **Sara huquqshunoslikni o'qigan** Oksford Londondan poyezdda atigi bir soatlik yo'l.

sentences.text: My parents met in 1995, **when** they were both students in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam 1995-yilda tanishgan — **o'shanda** ikkalasi ham Toshkentda talaba edi.

sentences.text: Madina, **whose** son is studying in Manchester, visits England twice a year.
sentences.translation: **O'g'li Manchesterda o'qiyotgan** Madina yiliga ikki marta Angliyaga boradi.

examples.title: Object: **who(m)** / **which** can't be left out
examples.description: who / which ergash gapda to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa ham tushib qolmaydi. Odam uchun rasmiy uslubda whom, og'zaki nutqda who.

sentences.text: Professor Brown, **whom** I met at a conference in Oxford, has invited me to give a talk.
sentences.translation: Oksforddagi konferensiyada **tanishgan** professor Braun meni ma'ruza qilishga taklif qildi.

sentences.text: My new boss, **who** I really like, gives everyone Friday afternoons off.
sentences.translation: **Menga juda yoqadigan** yangi boshlig'im juma kuni tushdan keyin hammaga dam beradi.

sentences.text: Madina's plov, **which** everyone praised, was cooked in a huge kazan over an open fire.
sentences.translation: Madinaning **hamma maqtagan** palovi ochiq olovda, katta qozonda pishirilgan edi.

sentences.text: My report, **which** I sent you yesterday, needs a few more changes.
sentences.translation: Kecha sizga **yuborgan** hisobotimga yana bir nechta o'zgartirish kiritish kerak.

sentences.text: Mrs Patel, **whom** we interviewed last week, has accepted the job.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta **suhbatdan o'tkazganimiz** missis Patel ishga rozi bo'ldi.

sentences.text: This jacket, **which** I bought in a sale, was only twenty pounds.
sentences.translation: **Chegirmada sotib olgan** bu kurtkam atigi yigirma funt edi.

sentences.text: Our English teacher, **who** all the students adore, is leaving at the end of the year.
sentences.translation: **Barcha talabalar yaxshi ko'radigan** ingliz tili o'qituvchimiz yil oxirida ketyapti.

sentences.text: Nilufar showed me her wedding photos, **which** she had kept in an old album.
sentences.translation: Nilufar menga to'y suratlarini ko'rsatdi — **ularni** eski albomda saqlab kelgan ekan.

sentences.text: Kate's brother, **whom** I've never actually met, always sends me a message on my birthday.
sentences.translation: Keytning akasi — **u bilan hech qachon uchrashmaganman** — har doim tug'ilgan kunimda xabar yuboradi.

sentences.text: My phone, **which** I dropped in the river last summer, still works perfectly!
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda daryoga **tushirib yuborgan** telefonim hali ham a'lo ishlayapti!

examples.title: Defining or extra? **my brother who** / **my brother, who**
examples.description: Juft gaplar: vergulsiz — guruhdan qaysi biri ekanini ajratadi, vergul bilan — hammasi haqida qo'shimcha xabar. Vergul ma'noni o'zgartiradi.

sentences.text: My brother **who lives** in Bukhara is a doctor, but my other brother is a lawyer.
sentences.translation: **Buxoroda yashaydigan** akam shifokor, boshqa akam esa huquqshunos.

sentences.text: My brother, **who lives** in Bukhara, is a doctor, and my sister is a nurse.
sentences.translation: Akam — **u Buxoroda yashaydi** — shifokor, opam esa hamshira.

sentences.text: The passengers **who had** tickets were allowed to board the train.
sentences.translation: Faqat **chiptasi bor** yo'lovchilarga poyezdga chiqishga ruxsat berildi.

sentences.text: The passengers, **who had waited** for hours, were finally allowed to board.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar — **ular soatlab kutishgan edi** — nihoyat poyezdga chiqishga ruxsat olishdi.

sentences.text: Students **who miss** more than three classes can't take the final exam.
sentences.translation: Uchtadan ortiq **dars qoldirgan** talabalar yakuniy imtihonni topshira olmaydi.

sentences.text: Oliver's students, **who are** all over eighteen, can choose their own topics.
sentences.translation: Oliverning talabalari — **hammasi o'n sakkizdan oshgan** — mavzularini o'zlari tanlay oladi.

sentences.text: Where's the charger **that came** with this laptop?
sentences.translation: Bu noutbuk bilan **birga kelgan** zaryadlovchi qayerda?

sentences.text: I gave Aziz my old laptop, **which is** slow but still good for studying.
sentences.translation: Azizga eski noutbukimni berdim — **u** sekin, lekin o'qish uchun hali yaraydi.

sentences.text: The houses **which were damaged** in the flood will be rebuilt by the government.
sentences.translation: **Suv toshqinida zarar ko'rgan** uylarni hukumat qayta quradi.

sentences.text: All the houses in our street, **which were built** in the 1960s, need new roofs.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi barcha uylarning — **ular 1960-yillarda qurilgan** — tomini yangilash kerak.

examples.title: At the end of the sentence: ..., **who** / ..., **which**
examples.description: Ergash gap gapning oxirida — bitta vergul bilan. Ko'pincha to'ldiruvchi bo'lib kelgan odam yoki narsaga qo'shimcha xabar.

sentences.text: Yesterday I had lunch with Sarah, **who has** just **come back** from Japan.
sentences.translation: Kecha Sara bilan tushlik qildim — **u** Yaponiyadan endigina **qaytgan**.

sentences.text: We spent the weekend in Khiva, **which looks** like an open-air museum.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlarini Xivada o'tkazdik — **u** ochiq osmon ostidagi muzeyga **o'xshaydi**.

sentences.text: I've just finished the report, **which took** me nearly three days.
sentences.translation: Hisobotni hozirgina tugatdim — **unga** qariyb uch kun vaqtim **ketdi**.

sentences.text: The job was offered to Bekzod, **who had** the most experience.
sentences.translation: Ish **eng tajribali nomzod** — Bekzodga taklif qilindi.

sentences.text: Can you return these books to Mr Davies, **who works** in the library?
sentences.translation: Bu kitoblarni **kutubxonada ishlaydigan** mister Deyvisga qaytarib bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: My parents gave me their old car, **which** I only **use** at weekends.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam menga eski mashinalarini berishdi — **undan** faqat dam olish kunlari **foydalanaman**.

sentences.text: Our flight was delayed because of the fog, **which was** unusually thick that morning.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz tuman sababli kechikdi — o'sha tong **u** odatdagidan quyuq **edi**.

sentences.text: Tomorrow I'm meeting Nilufar's father, **who is** a well-known architect.
sentences.translation: Ertaga Nilufarning otasi bilan uchrashaman — **u** taniqli **me'mor**.

sentences.text: Please send the documents to our Manchester office, **which deals** with all applications.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, hujjatlarni **barcha arizalar bilan shug'ullanadigan** Manchester ofisimizga yuboring.

sentences.text: They named their daughter Malika, **which means** "queen" in Arabic.
sentences.translation: Qizlariga Malika deb ism qo'yishdi — **bu ism** arab tilida «qirolicha» **degani**.

examples.title: In the news: extra details about people and places
examples.description: Yangiliklar uslubi: qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi ergash gaplar aynan rasmiy matnlarda ko'p uchraydi — who, which, whose, where.

sentences.text: The Prime Minister, **who is visiting** Uzbekistan this week, met students in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: **Shu hafta O'zbekistonga tashrif buyurayotgan** bosh vazir Toshkentda talabalar bilan uchrashdi.

sentences.text: The fire, **which started** in the kitchen of a café, quickly spread to nearby buildings.
sentences.translation: Bir kafening oshxonasida **boshlangan** yong'in tezda qo'shni binolarga tarqaldi.

sentences.text: Police are looking for the driver, **who left** the scene without stopping.
sentences.translation: Politsiya haydovchini qidirmoqda — **u** to'xtamasdan voqea joyidan **qochib ketgan**.

sentences.text: Last year's winner, **who is** only nineteen, will defend her title in Manchester next month.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yilgi g'olib — **u atigi o'n to'qqiz yoshda** — kelasi oy Manchesterda unvonini himoya qiladi.

sentences.text: The singer, **whose** last album sold millions of copies, has cancelled her world tour.
sentences.translation: **So'nggi albomi millionlab nusxada sotilgan** qo'shiqchi jahon gastrolini bekor qildi.

sentences.text: Doctors at the city hospital, **where** the injured were taken, say most of them are doing well.
sentences.translation: **Jarohatlanganlar olib borilgan** shahar shifoxonasi shifokorlarining aytishicha, ularning ko'pchiligi yaxshi ahvolda.

sentences.text: Mr Rakhimov, **who has run** the company since 2010, announced his retirement yesterday.
sentences.translation: 2010-yildan beri **kompaniyani boshqarib kelayotgan** janob Rahimov kecha nafaqaga chiqishini e'lon qildi.

sentences.text: Visitors to the city museum, **which reopens** on Friday after repairs, will get free entry for a month.
sentences.translation: Ta'mirdan keyin juma kuni **qayta ochiladigan** shahar muzeyiga bir oy davomida kirish bepul bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Heavy snow in the mountains, **which is** rare in October, has closed several roads.
sentences.translation: Tog'lardagi kuchli qor — **oktabrda bu kamdan-kam uchraydi** — bir nechta yo'lni yopib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: According to the report, Tashkent, **which** now **has** over three million people, needs more public transport.
sentences.translation: Hisobotga ko'ra, **aholisi hozir uch milliondan oshgan** Toshkentga ko'proq jamoat transporti kerak.

examples.title: Mixed: work, travel and family
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: who, whom, which, whose, where, when — gapning o'rtasida va oxirida, kundalik vaziyatlarda.

sentences.text: Our hotel in Edinburgh, **which** we **booked** online, turned out to be a tiny room above a pub.
sentences.translation: **Internet orqali band qilgan** Edinburgdagi mehmonxonamiz pab tepasidagi kichkina xona bo'lib chiqdi.

sentences.text: I'm going to ask Oliver, **who knows** a lot about computers, to look at my laptop.
sentences.translation: Kompyuterlar haqida **ko'p narsa biladigan** Oliverdan noutbukimni ko'rib berishini so'rayman.

sentences.text: Samarkand, **where** we spent our honeymoon, is still our favourite city.
sentences.translation: **Asal oyimizni o'tkazgan** Samarqand hali ham eng sevimli shahrimiz.

sentences.text: My colleague Madina, **whose** daughter has just started school, now leaves work at four.
sentences.translation: **Qizi endigina maktabga borgan** hamkasbim Madina endi ishdan soat to'rtda ketadi.

sentences.text: We visited the castle in the late afternoon, **when** most of the tour groups had already left.
sentences.translation: Qal'aga kechga yaqin bordik — **o'sha paytda** sayyohlar guruhlarining ko'pchiligi allaqachon ketib bo'lgan edi.

sentences.text: The tickets, **which cost** us almost two hundred pounds, were for the wrong day!
sentences.translation: Bizga **qariyb ikki yuz funtga tushgan** chiptalar boshqa kunga ekan!

sentences.text: Jasur's new flat, **which** he **shares** with two friends, is close to the university.
sentences.translation: Jasurning yangi kvartirasi — **u yerda ikki do'sti bilan yashaydi** — universitetga yaqin.

sentences.text: Last night I phoned my aunt, **who** I **hadn't spoken** to for months.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun xolamga qo'ng'iroq qildim — **u bilan oylardan beri gaplashmagan edim**.

sentences.text: The doctor, **whom** I **saw** on Monday, told me to rest and drink plenty of water.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni **qabulida bo'lgan** shifokor menga dam olishni va ko'p suv ichishni aytdi.

sentences.text: Kate now works for a charity in London, **which helps** homeless young people find jobs.
sentences.translation: Keyt hozir Londondagi xayriya tashkilotida ishlaydi — **u** uysiz yoshlarga ish topishda **yordam beradi**.
